target.title: fix(coding-agent): isolate Codex CLI CODEX_HOME from OpenClaw OAuth in skill launch forms
target.body:
Closes #109704

AI-assisted: built with Codex

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the bundled `coding-agent` skill's documented Codex CLI
launch forms use the ambient `CODEX_HOME` (`~/.codex` default), which can share
the same ChatGPT OAuth credential with OpenClaw's own `openai` provider.
When both clients use the same account's refresh token, one client can consume
or rotate the token, causing the other to fail with `refresh_token_reused`.
This leaves OpenClaw unable to make model requests until manual re-authentication.

## Why This Change Was Made

The `coding-agent` skill's documented `codex exec` launch forms now scope
Codex CLI to a dedicated `CODEX_HOME` kept **outside** every Git worktree so it
never discovers the ambient `~/.codex` credential and never places OAuth
credentials (`auth.json`) inside a checkout the coding worker may commit from.

Three locations are updated:

- **Hard rule**: instructs operators to create a `CODEX_HOME` outside every Git
  worktree (`mkdir -p <safe-path> && chmod 700 <safe-path>`), authenticate once,
  and prepend it to every `codex exec` launch. Warns that `$CODEX_HOME/auth.json`
  must never be staged or committed.
- **Codex launch form**: uses `/safe/path/.codex-isolated` instead of a
  worktree-relative path.
- **Scratch Codex**: allocates a dedicated `mktemp -d` directory outside
  `$SCRATCH` with mode 700 instead of creating `.codex-home` inside the scratch
  repo.

The runtime's bounded-turn path already isolates `CODEX_HOME`; this fix brings
the skill's manual launch forms into alignment with a safe external-home
convention.

## User Impact

Users who authenticate both OpenClaw and Codex CLI with the same ChatGPT
account no longer risk OpenClaw OAuth breakage when the `coding-agent` skill
launches a Codex worker. Codex credentials and session state are never placed
inside a Git checkout.

## Evidence

Runtime already isolates CODEX_HOME in the bounded-turn path:

```
extensions/codex/src/app-server/bounded-turn.ts:101  codexHome = path.join(workspace.dir, "codex-home")
extensions/codex/src/app-server/bounded-turn.ts:282  CODEX_HOME: codexHome
```

Skill launch forms before this change (ambient `~/.codex`):

```
bash ... command:"codex exec - < \"$PROMPT\""
```

Skill launch forms after this change (scoped, external, mode 700):

```
bash ... command:"CODEX_HOME=/safe/path/.codex-isolated codex exec - < \"$PROMPT\""
```

Scratch Codex before (CODEX_HOME inside git repo):

```
mkdir -p "$SCRATCH/.codex-home"
... command:"codex exec - < \"$PROMPT\""
```

Scratch Codex after (CODEX_HOME outside git repo, mode 700):

```
CODEX_HOME=$(mktemp -d)
chmod 700 "$CODEX_HOME"
... command:"CODEX_HOME=$CODEX_HOME codex exec - < \"$PROMPT\""
```

Docs-only change; no runtime behavior, tests, or build output affected.
